description: Fix 4 issues from semantic review: ChannelUpdateSort error handling, cache returning nil, sidebar active-state for custom channels, migration dedup key
steps: 1. Fix ChannelUpdateSort in internal/handlers/admin/channel_handlers.go to fail-fast on first error instead of swallowing errors
2. Fix ChannelCache.Get() in internal/cache/channel_cache.go to return []models.Channel{} instead of nil
3. Fix active-state detection in web/components/topic/topics-nav-content.tsx to use URL matching for custom channels
4. Fix migration dedup in migrations/000026_migration_script_channels.go to use Href instead of Name
acceptance_criteria: pnpm typecheck passes in web/ directory
ChannelUpdateSort returns error on first failure
ChannelCache.Get() returns empty slice instead of nil
Active-state logic works for channels with arbitrary hrefs
Migration uses Href as dedup key
findings: All 4 review issues fixed and verified. go build ./... passes, go vet ./... passes, pnpm typecheck passes. Note: go build requires a placeholder web/build/spa/index.html since embed.go references the SPA build output.
